title: negative-paraconsistent-settling-sheaf
description: The bilattice-negation mirror of the paraconsistent settling-associated sheaf: a sheaf that tracks newly-added negative-Belnap-designated cells (those transitioning to f or top, gaining a falsity-component) rather than positive ones, generated by applying FOUR negation cell-wise before forming the paraconsistent sheaf.

negativeBelnapDesignatedCells.description: for each (q, tau), the set of cells (s, o) whose valuation first enters {f, top} at tau, dualized to Priestley points and intersected with U; the stalk is the free abelian group Z over that point set

negationMirror.description: F_U^{(k,-)} = F_U^{(k)} . neg, where bilattice negation neg : FOUR -> FOUR swaps t <-> f and fixes bot, top; functoriality and basic properties transfer through neg rather than being re-derived

inconsistencyMeet.description: F_U^{(k)} intersect F_U^{(k,-)} congruent F_U^{(top)} at the cell-set level: cells both newly-truth-positive and newly-falsehood-positive at tau are exactly those transitioning to top
